title: Dashboard and room card: card, status rows, empty state, dialog
goal: The dashboard and room card use bricks card, status row, empty state and dialog
acceptance: Room and pot cards are bricks cards; alert lines are status rows with the warn or bad tone; empty lists use the empty-state pattern
Harvest, bloom and flush confirmations use the bricks dialog
Pump control and probe tiles stay as they are until F-020-T07; room-card styles shrink to Grover-only layout
privacy: Neutral, invented test data only; no Tailscale names, IPs, agent tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner
A bricks component that cannot take Grover's look through the theme goes to bricks as a proposal, never a local override

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-25: room-card.scss is 285 lines with the most status logic. Not a measurement.
